text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned right groin pain and abnormal leg positioning after a rear-end collision; can you describe exactly how your leg is positioned and what specific movement makes the pain worst?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) tear with concomitant hip pathology (likely acetabular fracture or labral tear) secondary to rear-end collision.
